title: Prove Settings-denied workspace writes never invoke the write module
goal: Strengthen the canonical M8 regression so a Settings-backed write denial proves the workspace write module was never invoked and no successful Skill observation was emitted.
context: Issue #347 requires production Settings capability toggles to be honored at the actual Module boundary. Existing integration coverage asserts denial and absence of a file, but does not explicitly assert the write capability was not invoked or reported as successful.
forbidden_changes: Do not change production execution behavior or weaken policy enforcement.
Do not change workspace path restrictions, approval handling, schema validation, cancellation, or verification.
Do not treat absence of a file alone as proof that no capability execution occurred.
Do not claim physical-device acceptance from CI.
acceptance_criteria: With the Settings-backed write capability disabled, the canonical chat Skill call is denied.
The denied request does not emit a moduleInvoked event for tool.workspace.write.
The denied request does not emit a successful/verified observation for workspace.create-file.
No denied target file is created.
After enabling write capability, the existing positive path still writes exact content and returns verified success.
Agent Task Contract, M3, and Apple Native Build & Unsigned IPA pass.
verification: Confirm all three required PR workflows pass.
